gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed recurrent glioblastoma (grade IV) as per WHO criteria 2021 (IDH- wild type only)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Documented recurrent disease (radiological, based on RANO v.1.0) within 3 months prior to first study drug administration with no suitable standard of care options available.

role_evidence.quote: Phase I open-label trial of 123I-ATT001 monotherapy and in combination with treatment therapies in subjects with relapsed glioblastoma.
